messages:
Sara (Support): :rotating_light: Customer acme-prod hitting 503s for hosted inference since ~09:58 UTC. Multiple requests failing with upstream worker crashes. CS on call is looped in.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Looking now. Any logs or request ids?
Sara (Support): Pasted a few request ids from the customer and the gateway logs. They all map to the same upstream runner id. Example: req=acme-req-9891. From gateway: 
```
upstream_health: worker exited abruptly (exit_code=139), route=hosted-infer-1, last_log=segfault
```
```
container: infer-runner-7f9d; crash reason: SIGSEGV
```

Mike (Eng Oncall): SIGSEGV + exit 139 usually matches native crash. Any evidence of CUDA OOM vs bad pointer?
Raj (SRE): nvml shows a memory spike on GPU0 before the crash. OOM isn't explicit in the runner logs but dmesg shows: 
```
[7100001.234] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3a:00.0: GPU memory used suddenly jumped
[7100001.241] infer-runner[2345]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f... sp 00007ff...
```

Toni (Customer Success): Customer reported this started after they pushed a model switch (quantized-v2 -> quantized-v3) around 09:50. They replayed identical requests against older model and didn't see failures.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Good clue. Quantized swap + unexpected kernel may trigger new code path. Can we repro on staging with the same quantized build?
Raj (SRE): Spun up a pool with the customer's model + high concurrency. After ~2000 requests, runner crashed with same SIGSEGV. Captured coredump and nvcrash logs.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Assigning to me. Steps I'm taking: 1) demote the model on hosted (route to quantized-v2) 2) block autoscale from returning traffic to the failing pool 3) collect coredump, nvml logs, and kernel backtrace.
Sara (Support): Notifying customer of mitigation: routing to fallback model. They're sensitive to latency but accept short-term fallback.
deploy-bot: [deployment] traffic reroute to quantized-v2 started by mike (eng-oncall) at 10:07 UTC
Toni (Customer Success): Customer acknowledged. Will monitor errors.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Preliminary backtrace shows crash in fused-attn kernel after KV cache resize: 
```
#0  0x7f9a1d2a in fused_attn_forward(...) +0x4a
#1  0x7f9a2b3c in kv_cache_update(...) +0x1c
#2  0x7f9a3cde in model_infer_main +0x2f4
```
No explicit CUDA OOM reported, but memory accounting inconsistent. Suspect memory ballooning during quantized kernel path.
Raj (SRE): Snapshot of GPU memory timeline attached to thread (link). Also saw concurrent batches of size 32 and many long-context requests (ctx > 32k tokens) at the same time.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Repro notes we've confirmed: run load with mixed long-context streams + batch size 24-32 on quantized-v3 causes mem spike -> segfault in fused kernel. Repro script (dev): 
```
# quick repro (staging)
ab -n 5000 -c 50 -p long_ctx.json https://staging-hosted/v1/generate?model=quantized-v3
```

Sara (Support): Customer impact: 15% error rate on p95-99 windows, spike coincided with billing window but no double-billing reported. CS asked to flag for billing review if issue persists.
Toni (Customer Success): I'll open a billing guardrail ticket preemptively.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Short-term mitigations applied: 1) route traffic off failing pool, 2) enforce max batch size=16 for quantized-v3 pools, 3) apply a temp rate limit for long-context (>16k) requests for that model. These reduced errors to baseline in staging.
Raj (SRE): For longer-term: we need a kernel-level fix and improved memory accounting for quantized kernels. Also add a circuit-breaker to terminate runaway memory users before segfault.
Mike (Eng Oncall): Action items (owner in parens):
- Upload coredump + nvml logs to S3 and link in ticket (Mike)
- Open internal bug: fused-attn mem growth on quantized-v3 (Mike/Eng-ML)
- Add preemptive memory limit + CB on runner (Raj/Eng-Infer)
- Add an automated canary that runs long-context load for new quantized builds (Eng-ML/QA)
- CS billing watch (Toni)

Sara (Support): Customer wants ETA — can we give them an estimate?
Mike (Eng Oncall): I can provide a mitigation ETA: rollback routing done (done), temporary tuning applied (done). Root-cause fix ETA depends on Eng-ML; initial triage suggests 2-3 business days for a patch + canary. I'll update customer tomorrow EOD.
Toni (Customer Success): Noted. I'll tell customer about the 48-72h window and that we've applied fallbacks.
Sara (Support): Closing loop for now — moving to follow-up channel once bug is opened. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng Oncall): Leaving this thread for the bug ticket. If you need live updates ping me in #eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: [incident] ticket opened: BUG-45321 fused-attn mem growth on quantized-v3 (owner: mike)
